tool_input.description: Exit code, dev run, tests, guren check

result:
Posts can now be scheduled. All six stages of `bunx guren gate` pass, including `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (8 tests, 6 of them new in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`). I also ran `posts:scheduled` against the test database: it exits 0, prints only the tab-separated lines soonest first, and prints nothing on stdout when a fresh database migrates and seeds itself.

- **Storage:** there is a new nullable `published_at` text column on `posts`, added in `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260925015353_add_published_at_to_posts/`.
- **Form field:** `publishAt` on create and edit accepts an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone, or `null`. Anything else, like `next tuesday`, gets the same 422 as an empty title and nothing is saved. Because absent means "publish now", an edit request that leaves `publishAt` out clears an existing date rather than keeping it. The edit form always sends the field, so this only matters for other clients.
- **Who sees what:** the posts list and search show public posts to everyone plus the viewer's own scheduled posts. A scheduled post's page returns 404 to anyone but its author.
- **Time passing:** the "is it live yet" check runs on every request, so nothing needs to run when the time arrives.

The list and search filters compare `published_at` as text against the current time in `toISOString()` form (`…T09:00:00.000Z`). That is correct for the UTC ISO values the check writes. If someone put a different format straight into the database, such as `+00:00` instead of `Z`, the list and search could be wrong about whether that post is live. The single-post page and the report parse the date properly and aren't affected.

I also changed `bin/console.ts`. The ORM prints "Applied N migration(s)…" to stdout while the app starts, which would have broken "nothing else on stdout" on any database with pending migrations. Startup messages now go to stderr, and commands still write to stdout.

In summary: I added the `published_at` column and migration; added `publishAt` to `PostPayloadSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`; gave `app/Models/Post.ts` helpers for which posts a viewer can see, which posts are scheduled, and whether one post is scheduled; and updated `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` so the list and search use the visibility filter, the post page returns 404 to non-authors, and store and update save `publishAt`. `PostResource` now includes `publishedAt`. The "Publish at" field is on `resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` and `Edit.tsx`, with time-zone conversion helpers in `resources/js/components/publishAt.ts`, and the list and post pages show when a scheduled post goes live. The `posts:scheduled` report is in `app/Console/Commands/ListScheduledPostsCommand.ts`, registered in `src/console.ts`. `bin/console.ts` sends startup logs to stderr, and `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts` covers the contract.
